title: DiffShow
tagline: Open-source CLI for polished, portable Git change reports.
description:
DiffShow is an open-source npm package.

DiffShow turns local Git changes into a polished, self-contained before-and-after report, making it easier to see:

→ Which files changed
→ The code before and after
→ Added and removed lines
→ Differences between branches or commits
→ Staged, unstaged, and untracked changes

Install it globally:

npm install -g diffshow

Generate a report:

diffshow

Compare two branches:

diffshow compare main feature-branch

It also supports commit comparisons, Markdown output, custom output paths, exclusions, and configurable context lines. The full command reference is available in the repository.

Everything runs locally. There is no server, account, telemetry, or source-code upload. Your code stays on your machine.

Building DiffShow taught me much more than implementing the tool itself. I gained hands-on experience with Git internals, CLI design, npm packaging, automated testing, accessibility, security, semantic versioning, and maintaining a real open-source project.

title: Coursezy
description:
Coursezy is a modern, AI-powered full-stack learning platform built with Laravel 12 and React 19 + TypeScript. At the heart of the platform is an intelligent AI agent built using LangChain and Hugging Face, enabling advanced conversational assistance, smart content interaction, and dynamic learning support.

The backend exposes a secure RESTful API with Sanctum authentication, real-time broadcasting via Pusher, and scalable media handling through Cloudinary. On the frontend, Vite ensures high performance, Redux Toolkit manages global state, and Tailwind CSS with Radix UI delivers a clean, accessible, and responsive interface enriched with smooth animations and optional 3D experiences.

By combining modern full-stack architecture with an AI-driven agent layer, Coursezy demonstrates scalable backend engineering, real-time systems integration, and intelligent application design in a production-ready environment.

title: Marketing Website
tagline: Production-grade full-stack marketing website with CMS integrations and SEO optimization.
description:
A production-grade, full-stack marketing website built for a real client, featuring a headless CMS architecture that decouples content management from the frontend for performance and flexibility.

I contributed to the project by implementing key frontend features and CMS integrations:

Frontend (marketing-site): Assisted with component-driven architecture, GSAP animations, dynamic cookie consent system, GDPR-compliant cookie management, and integration of the HubSpot lead generation form. Worked with Astro, TypeScript, SCSS/Sass, Swiper.js sliders, and Vimeo video embeds.

CMS (marketing-site-cms): Supported content structuring in Strapi v5 with PostgreSQL, media management via AWS S3, and implementation of SEO plugins and user permission settings.

I am also actively working on SEO optimization for this project with support from the team, improving metadata quality, technical search readiness, and overall discoverability.

title: Arije Academia
tagline: Arije Academia is a full-featured web platform designed to manage and showcase wellness and therapeutic
description:
Arije Academia is a full-featured web platform designed to manage and showcase wellness and therapeutic training courses. It delivers a rich, multi-language experience in Arabic, French, and English, with dynamic course pages, service landing pages, and an interactive contact system.

Built with Laravel 12 and MongoDB, the platform supports flexible course content, nested translations, curriculum structures, certifications, FAQs, and related courses. The frontend leverages Blade, Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js, and Swiper.js for a responsive, modern UI.

Key highlights:

Multi-language support with RTL for Arabic

Dynamic course and service pages loaded from MongoDB

Modular Blade components for reusable UI elements

Authentication and user management via Laravel Breeze

Smooth, interactive frontend powered by Tailwind and Alpine.js

Arije Academia demonstrates modern full-stack engineering, flexible data modeling, and a polished user experience for educational platforms.

title: Fault Finder
tagline: WCAG 2.2 accessibility demo site with real fail/pass examples.
description:
Fault Finder is an educational accessibility demo site built to make WCAG 2.2 criteria easier to understand through hands-on examples. The application organizes 87 success criteria across Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, and Robust, with a clear dashboard, persistent criteria navigation, and direct routes for individual examples.

I reviewed the live site across the overview, criteria navigation, contrast, ARIA widget, and status message examples. The experience includes WCAG reference links, nested sidebar navigation, and paired fail/pass demonstrations that explain what breaks accessibility and how the corrected implementation resolves it.

The project highlights accessible UI education, structured content modeling for a large technical reference, interactive React components, and thoughtful information architecture for developers and accessibility reviewers.

title: CV Reviewer
tagline: CV Reviewer is an AI-powered resume analysis tool built with LangChain
description:
CV Reviewer is an AI-driven application designed to generate structured, recruiter-style feedback on resumes. The goal was not simply to integrate a language model, but to build a system where AI logic and frontend experience work seamlessly together.

The AI layer is powered by LangChain with Llama-3, enabling structured prompt chaining and consistent, professional outputs. A custom PDF/DOCX parsing pipeline ensures reliable text extraction before analysis. On the frontend, React + TypeScript deliver a responsive interface with dynamic visualizations that present insights clearly — not just raw text.

Special attention was given to handling unpredictable LLM latency, maintaining smooth UI rendering during long asynchronous processes, and ensuring structured, recruiter-quality feedback.

CV Reviewer demonstrates practical AI orchestration, thoughtful UX design, and real-world application of modern full-stack engineering.

title: FindMyPet
tagline: FindMyPet is a QR-based pet identification web app built with React, TypeScript, and Firebase,
description:
FindMyPet is a practical web application designed to help reunite lost pets with their owners quickly and safely. The platform allows pet owners to submit their personal information along with their pet's details through a simple form. Once submitted, the system generates a unique QR code that can be attached to the pet's collar.

When the QR code is scanned, a clean and responsive public page instantly displays the pet's information and the owner's contact details, making it easy for anyone who finds the animal to reach out.

Built with React + TypeScript on the frontend and powered by Firebase as a Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) for real-time data storage and image hosting, the project demonstrates how modern web technologies can transform a simple idea into a meaningful, real-world solution.

title: Project 5 – Jewelry Store Showcase
tagline: A modern jewelry store application focused on premium visual presentation and intuitive browsing.
description:
Project 5 – Jewelry Store Showcase is a modern jewelry store application designed to showcase products in a clean, organized, and visually appealing way. The experience focuses on intuitive navigation, clear content structure, and refined UI details that reflect the premium nature of jewelry items.

Key highlights:

Organized product catalog with clear categories

Responsive and user-friendly design

Consistent architecture with existing projects

Emphasis on visual presentation and product details
